methodology: A/B test of every non-redirect skill native to AudiobookMaker (ai-codegen-smell-audit and audit excluded — they are claude-skills library duplicates routed elsewhere). Arm A: Sonnet sub-agent solves the task cold, no SKILL.md access, explicit instruction not to read .claude/skills/ or CLAUDE.md. Arm B: Sonnet sub-agent reads .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and follows it. Both arms produced a real artifact (markdown plan or proposed change), no side-effect commands executed. Token usage from harness's per-sub-agent usage.total_tokens — input + output + cache_creation; cache_read excluded as cache hits paid upstream. N=1 per skill.

task_briefs.ci-failure-triage: Triage hypothetical CI failure: pytest collection error importing AudiobookSession from src.audiobook.session. Produce a fix plan.
task_briefs.copyright-scan: Scan AudiobookMaker src/ for accidental third-party copyright leaks. Pass/fail verdict + file:line findings.
task_briefs.pronunciation-corpus-add: Add Finnish pronunciation failure ('tervetuloa' as 'ter-ve-too-loa') to docs/pronunciation_corpus_fi.md. Output proposed entry only, no actual write.
task_briefs.release-bundle-audit: Audit PyInstaller bundle spec for unused deps + dead-code data files. Propose spec-only fixes.
task_briefs.release-cut: Walk through cutting release v3.99.0 — produce plan document, no actual tag or push.
task_briefs.voice-pack-finnish: Plan Finnish voice pack pipeline for hypothetical 90s clip with 2 speakers (1F, 1M). Plan only, no audio processing.
task_briefs.work-session: As Claude 3, pick a free task from TODO.md and produce the proposed TODO.md edit. No actual file modification.
task_briefs.worktree-launch: Plan launching a parallel session in worktree .claude/worktrees/chore-test-calibration-stub. Plan only, no worktree creation.

skills.name: release-bundle-audit
skills.notes: skill encodes thoroughness (multi-phase audit walk) — arm B explored deeper, used 121 tool uses vs arm A's 56. Costs more per use, value is in audit completeness, not token compression.

skills.name: work-session
skills.notes: skill encodes status-board protocol rigor (3-part TODO.md edit, isolation discipline) — costs slightly more per use, value is multi-Claude coherence, not token compression.

skills.name: worktree-launch
skills.notes: N=1 noise — no meaningful save or cost difference on this task. Skill's value is correctness (avoiding worktree collisions), not token compression.

cross_portfolio_observation: Aggregate 23% save rate matches Spacepotatis's 22% almost exactly. Two skills cost MORE (release-bundle-audit -12%, work-session -10%) — both encode rigor or protocol discipline rather than scout-savings, same pattern as Spacepotatis's security-audit / equipment. The skills that save the most (copyright-scan 49%, voice-pack-finnish 52%, ci-failure-triage 43%) are the ones where the recipe collapses an open-ended investigation into a directed walk.
